dedupe_keys.name: renewable natural gas flow rate estimation tool

description: The US Environmental Protection Agency Renewable Natural Gas Flow Rate Estimation Tool estimates how landfill-gas flow and heat content change when a collection wellfield is adjusted to meet an inlet nitrogen specification for renewable-natural-gas processing. The tool uses landfill-specific gas flow and composition where available and supplies default assumptions for nitrogen, methane, carbon dioxide and oxygen. Its purpose is an approximate screening estimate before an energy project proceeds to detailed assessment. The intended delivery method and end-use gas specification affect the allowable inlet nitrogen level. Calculations describe a user-defined landfill and operating condition; the resource is not a measured time series or a spatial inventory. EPA provides the January 2023 tool as an Excel workbook through a public page without a stated charge. A reuse licence was not established from that page. It supports capacity planning for landfill-gas treatment and energy recovery, but defaults do not establish the performance of a particular wellfield. LandGEM is a related landfill-gas generation model. No workbook was downloaded or executed.
